prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Create a polished original flat vector-style logo SYMBOL ONLY for a Russian software distribution platform named "Релизы". This is a tool for releasing multiple independent applications, no specific operating system.
Direction: a compact, bold Cyrillic capital Р monogram (same silhouette as Latin P), with one clean 45-degree cut and a tiny forward-pointing wedge released from its upper right shoulder. Build a very simple geometric shape from rounded rectangular masses; wide negative-space counter, thick upright stem; beautifully balanced optical geometry. It must remain recognizable at 16px. No intricate details.
Color palette from the existing UI: deep forest green #143c36 main shape, pale green #c3e9b7 small released wedge, all other background truly transparent.
Show one large centered isolated symbol, straight-on, flat solid fills and sharp edges. No text, no wordmark, no labels, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no surface mockup, no decorative particles, no watermark. Composition square with generous outer safe margin. Professional restrained technology identity.

Use case: logo-brand.
Create a polished original flat vector-style logo SYMBOL ONLY for a Russian software distribution platform named "Релизы". The platform publishes different applications and stable/beta versions.
Direction: three bold rounded rectangular release layers, arranged as a compact upward-stepping stack, each successive layer moved a little upward and to the right, like version progression. The uppermost layer is separated and has a tiny intentional squared notch suggesting an active version. Simple planar geometry with beautiful negative spaces, not an isometric cube or a database cylinder. All layers are substantial and readable at favicon size.
Use deep forest green #143c36 for lower layers and the UI's medium green #236b54 for the top one. Background truly transparent.
One isolated centered symbol, square canvas, generous safe margin. Premium minimal SaaS identity. No text, no wordmark, no labels, no numbers, no gradients, no shadows, no 3D, no mockup, no watermark.

Use case: logo-brand.
Create a polished original flat vector-style logo SYMBOL ONLY for a Russian software distribution platform named "Релизы".
Direction: an original compact release/forward sign constructed from two wide parallel 45-degree bent ribbons. At left they begin as short horizontal bars; at right they turn upward-right into two staggered bold arrow-like steps. Balanced compact and distinctive silhouette, conveying distribution and moving to the next release. Two pieces only; no thin strokes. This is a carefully designed solid geometric mark rather than a generic download icon. Readable at 16px.
Use forest green #143c36 for one ribbon and medium green #236b54 for the second, transparent background.
One centered isolated symbol, straight-on flat vector-like solid fills, no lettering, no text, no slogans, no gradients, no shadows, no mockup, no 3D, no watermark. Square framing with generous safe margin.
